title: Start a throwaway HTTP service and test against it in one step
demonstrates: leftover processes are cleaned up when the step ends

steps.script:
python3 -m http.server 18765 --bind 127.0.0.1 >/dev/null 2>&1 &
python3 - <<'PY'
import time, urllib.request
for _ in range(50):
    try:
        body = urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:18765/", timeout=1).read().decode()
        break
    except OSError:
        time.sleep(0.2)
else:
    raise SystemExit("service never became ready")
assert "Directory listing" in body, body[:200]
print("service answered; smoke test passed")
PY
# The server is still running here; the runner ends the whole process group after the step.
